emotional-intelligence.title: Emotional Intelligence

Through interactive sessions, attendees will delve into the significance of EI and its constructive influence on both professional and social aspects, intending to enhance the quality of their relationships in both work and personal life. advanced-communication-skills.title: Advanced Communication Skills
overview: Whether you are communicating under pressure, navigating interpersonal challenges, or aiming to establish lasting rapport, your communication style and proficiency are fundamental to enhancing your chances of achieving your goals. This course is designed to support you in becoming a more effective communicator by recognizing people's thinking patterns and preferred learning methods, allowing you to tailor your communication accordingly. Gaining a better understanding of your own communication style and how others communicate with you can enhance both business and personal relationships. Additionally, this course will assist you in refining your interaction skills, a crucial element for success in the workplace and beyond
audience: This course is designed for employees, supervisors, middle managers, and senior managers who aspire to elevate their communication skills to an advanced level by acquiring sophisticated techniques and strategies
methodology: The workshop is crafted to be interactive and participatory. The course structure rests on four pedagogical pillars: concept learning through presentations by the consultant, role-playing in group exercises, sharing experiences in roundtable discussions, and exposure to case studies and scenarios

creative-problem-solving-and-decision-ma.title: Creative Problem Solving and Decision Making
overview: In our daily lives, decisions range from simple choices like deciding what to eat when hungry to more complex issues such as prioritizing tasks at work or troubleshooting a failed process. These situations demand a rational approach to problem-solving. However, certain decisions, particularly those with significant implications for our lives or the lives of others, require critical thinking to ensure the absence of logical flaws. In some instances, problems may be so unique that they defy conventional and critical thinking, emphasizing the need for creative problem-solving skills
audience: Managers, supervisors, and administrators seeking enhanced problem-solving and decision-making skills, as well as business professionals aiming to elevate their critical thinking by incorporating both experience and intuition into their decision-making processes
methodology: The course incorporates various interactive techniques, including concise presentations by both the consultant and participants, rehearsed and impromptu role plays, video clips with comprehensive debriefs, and individual and group feedback
competencies: Problem-solving ability and anticipating potential problems
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Build and enhance decision-making, critical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills
Apply logical and creative approaches to problem-solving and decision-making
Utilize traditional and creative tools to identify causes and generate solutions
Employ creativity and lateral thinking as business tools
Analyze and solve real problems encountered in the workplace
Demonstrate and establish credibility with upper management
Develop strategic approaches to problem-solving and decision-making
